subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Across Cultures · Reading for Pleasure · Review and Reference
lesson: Reading for Pleasure: interview with Rumaitha Al Busaidi
outcomes: Read an interview and find the main ideas
Explain why it is important to protect Antarctica

tf.s: Rumaitha Al Busaidi travelled to Antarctica.
tf.why: The interview is about her journey there.

tf.s: The text is a story, not an interview.
tf.why: It is an interview with questions and answers.

tf.s: Rumaitha wants to preserve the Antarctic environment.
People go on expeditions to explore, do research and learn.
tf.why: That is the purpose of an expedition.
That is one reason it is important.

tf.s: To 'preserve' something means to destroy it.
tf.why: Preserve means to keep it safe.

tf.s: An interview is made of questions and answers.
tf.why: One person asks, the other answers.

tf.s: Young people cannot do anything to protect the environment.
tf.why: Young people can help in many ways.

tf.s: Young Omanis can learn courage from Rumaitha.

mcq.q: Where did Rumaitha Al Busaidi travel?

mcq.q: Which two things make Antarctica important?

o: Leave the lights on all day

mcq.q: Which question would you expect in an interview with Rumaitha?
o: Why did you decide to go to Antarctica?
